title: AlphaDiana：可验证推理任务中智能体的测量系统
summary: AlphaDiana 是一个模块化测量系统，用于评估智能体在可验证推理任务中的表现。研究发现，工具框架并不总能提升推理准确率，技能指导与历史记忆也未必可靠地改善性能，需结合正确性评估行为与token使用。
summary_en: AlphaDiana is a modular measurement system for evaluating agents on verifiable reasoning tasks. It finds that harnesses do not consistently improve reasoning accuracy, and neither skill guidance nor retained history reliably helps; behavior and token use must be assessed alongside correctness.
